title: Uber expands its Women Drivers matching feature nationwide, including in major US markets like New York City, Philadelphia, and DC, amid mounting assault cases (Natalie Lung/Bloomberg)
summary: Natalie Lung / Bloomberg: Uber expands its Women Drivers matching feature nationwide, including in major US markets like New York City, Philadelphia, and DC, amid mounting assault cases — Uber Technologies Inc. said that a feature designed to match female riders and drivers will be available nationwide …
